For the past year, I've been taking my 6-year-old cat to this vet, and I highly recommend them! I've seen two different doctors—Dr. Chotard and Dr. Fricker—and they're both fantastic, very attentive, and incredibly kind. The assistants here are also super friendly and professional. My cat isn't the easiest to handle at the vet, but they manage to calm him down in their arms during the consultation. It's a truly professional practice. I love it!

Dr. Laurent is the best, I highly recommend him 😻
I recommend him 100%, and so does my cat 😍

Excellent team! Veterinarians Dr. Fricker and Dr. Laurent take the time to thoroughly explain their diagnosis and recommendations...you don't feel rushed like you do in some clinics in the area. I highly recommend them!

I will be eternally grateful to the entire team at this clinic for caring for Géralt with such dedication, gentleness, and love until the very end. Suffering from cancer, he was always treated with immense compassion, and I, as his often worried and stressed owner, always found the team attentive, available to answer my questions, reassure me, and help me.

After consulting several veterinarians in Paris, I can say without hesitation that this clinic is, for me, the best I have ever encountered. Géralt was welcomed and cared for with such love. I left him in their care with complete peace of mind, knowing he was truly well looked after.

Even during the most difficult moments, they were there for him and for me, right up to his last breath. Géralt has passed away, but he was accompanied with dignity, gentleness, and immense love. A huge thank you to Dr. Chotard, Dr. Fricker, and Dr. Laurent, as well as the entire nursing team, for everything you did for him and for your support. You are a truly exceptional team. ❤️

I just had a bizarre conversation with the receptionist. My cat has been a vet at the 18th arrondissement clinic since he was born, and I've taken him there once or twice. I called them to get a prescription for some medication, but they flatly refused, claiming the vet in the 17th arrondissement hadn't seen him, despite the prescription from my own vet, who, of course, saw my cat a few days ago and wanted to save me the trip to the 18th to pick him up! I find this principle of refusing medication prescribed by a colleague simply insane: if you haven't paid 80 euros for a visit, you won't get it!
